summary: Frontend E2E for User Management (admin) verified end-to-end: login with new admin creds + MFA (TOTP), admin-only Users nav visible, Users list renders rows with avatar/role/MFA badges, create user, edit user (name/role/password), delete user with AlertDialog, self-delete button disabled. issues: Console warning: DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` (accessibility). Consider adding <DialogDescription> to create-user-dialog and edit-user-dialog.

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to Users create/edit dialogs to remove Radix aria warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.js: On avatar removal in edit form, backend PATCH payload sends avatar: '' every time (even when unchanged). This is fine since backend treats empty string similarly, but consider sending avatar only when the user actually changed it to avoid overwriting on unrelated edits.
Users.js: fileToAvatar has no explicit MIME check; relying on <input accept=image/*>. Backend should also validate the base64 payload size to prevent large-doc writes.
AppShell.js: `dark` initial state expression is convoluted (`!document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? false : true`) — simplify to `document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')`.
